notes.title: Hear My Cult - Update 25/04/2025
notes.notes:
Hello Callers,

The Beta Testing Phase continues in full force, and thanks to your incredible feedback, we’re summoning some of our biggest updates yet. We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the first procedural region in the game:

• Welcome to the Desert of Saj’enar
A cursed, windswept wasteland filled with secrets and sacrifice:

Hunt down scattered Villagers and Haywitch elites to claim their blood and offerings.

Mine Saltrock deposits to gain rare materials needed for higher-tier rituals.

Steal food supplies to keep your cult thriving amid the endless dunes.

Discover ancient Altars, each offering unique sacrifice options that twist the fate of your cult in strange and powerful ways.

It’s dangerous, chaotic, and ever-changing—exactly the kind of place Imo’tar would love to call home.

• Controller Icon Support (PlayStation & Xbox)
We’ve upgraded input feedback across the board:

You’ll now see the correct PlayStation or Xbox button icons on every screen based on your active controller.

Menus, tutorials, tooltips, and combat prompts all dynamically show your current input method—no more guessing.

This brings a massive improvement to controller immersion and makes gameplay more intuitive than ever.

• Keybinding Customization That Sticks
Your controls, your way—now with more reliability:

Fully rebind keyboard and controller buttons right in-game.

Changes persist across sessions and are shown immediately

All keybind displays now reflect your choices accurately, even during your very first ritual.

• First-Time Controller Setup – Now Smart
Plug in and play, without the headaches:

Your controller is now automatically recognized at launch, loading the correct defaults.

Even first-time players using controllers will see appropriate button icons and working input.

• Bug Fixes & Behind-the-Sands Improvements
Sharpening the ritual, one patch at a time:

Fixed a binding issue in the in-game settings panel that caused inputs to get stuck on "PRESS KEY TO ASSIGN."

Smoothed input transitions and eliminated lag spikes in combat-heavy scenes.

Improved performance when loading large procedural regions.

Join the Cult on Discord!
Join us here: 👉 https://discord.com/invite/CMrWZwMJv9

Thanks again, Callers, for your endless support, curiosity, and chaos.
Saj’enar is only the beginning… more rituals await.

Keep summoning. Keep sacrificing.
Frogtrain 🐸🚂

notes.title: Hear My Cult - Update 22/03/2025
notes.notes:
Hello Callers,

The Beta Testing Phase is in full swing, and I cannot thank you enough for your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions! Your input has been invaluable in refining the game, ensuring every mechanic is both engaging and intuitive. With your help, we’ve made some fantastic improvements over the past weeks.

Let’s dive into what’s new:

🟢 Minion Equipment Overhaul
Minions are now better equipped for battle!

Equipment readability has been vastly improved. You can now clearly see the weapons and armor your Minions are using, ensuring you make informed tactical decisions.
New item tooltips help you quickly understand the effects of Minion gear at a glance.

🟢 Enhanced Readability & UI Improvements
Navigating your cult's army should feel smooth and intuitive, so we made some major UI updates:

Better visual clarity for Minion Cards, making it easier to see stats, skills, and effects.
Improved ability descriptions so you always know what devastating spells and attacks are at your disposal.

🟢 A More Intuitive Tutorial Level
We’ve refined the onboarding experience to help new players get into the game faster:

The tutorial now provides clearer guidance on summoning and commanding your Minions.
Important mechanics like sacrificing Minions and using Idols are explained in a more organic way.
Improved controller support & input prompts ensure smooth gameplay across all control schemes.

🟢 Fixes & Refinements from Player Feedback
Thanks to your reports, we’ve tackled various quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes:

Minions no longer shuffle randomly when sacrificed, keeping your army organized and predictable.
Controller targeting is now even more responsive, making battles feel fluid and natural.
Various performance optimizations, reducing lag in large battles.

Join us on Discord! 👉 https://discord.com/invite/CMrWZwMJv9

Thank you again for being part of this dark, strategic, and chaotic adventure. Keep summoning, keep sacrificing, and let me know your thoughts!

notes.title: Hear My Cult - Update 22/02/2025
notes.notes:
Hello Callers,

The Beta Testing phase is underway, and I want to sincerely thank everyone for the valuable feedback received. As this is a complex game, there are many aspects to refine and polish, and your input is truly appreciated.

I’m excited to announce all the newly implemented features:

🟢 Sacrifice Minions
Minions can now be sacrificed to activate a unique ability specific to that minion.

The sacrifice-activated ability is displayed on the Minion’s Card info. Here are some examples:

Abominations will spawn three attacking Rotting Worms when sacrificed.
A Spellcasting Minion will grant nearby Minions a Spell-Resistance shield upon sacrifice.
A Voodoo Slave will summon a Taunting Totem that attracts nearby enemies.

🟢 Introducing Idols
Idols are statues that spawn during certain levels. They are procedurally placed throughout the map and can be unlocked by interacting with specific NPCs and completing levels.

Destroying an Idol grants powerful effects. Some examples:

The Idol of the Butcher gives the Cult Leader a new melee AoE attack that causes enemies to bleed out.
The Idol of the Tarantula spawns a poisonous spider to fight for you.

🟢 Expanded Main Attacks for the Cult Leader
Since the Cult Leader will frequently fight alongside their Minions, I’ve introduced new main attacks:

Massive Death Bolts that spawn skeletons when an enemy is slain.
Powerful melee slashes that stun enemies.

🟢 Improved Controller Targeting System
While the mouse & keyboard system functions as intended, I’ve been refining the controller experience to make commanding hordes of undead smoother.

The system now features a new Indicator that auto-targets enemies, making it easier to command Minions during battle.

Join the Official Discord Channel!
Join us to get more insights into Hear My Cult! 👉 https://discord.com/invite/CMrWZwMJv9

In our Discord Channel, we discuss:

Game features, mechanics, and strategies
Minions, Spells, Artifacts, and Perks
Ongoing updates and player feedback

Wishing you all a fantastic day, Callers! 🚂🐸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44413123/a94941a60cc2ad2e010534f3d71345c0955ed010.png[/img]

Good Day to you all Callers! I am excited to announce that Hear My Cult is currently in the first session of beta testing, and I have finally updated the Steam Page with:

- New Trailer
- New Screenshots
- New Cover Art

The beta testing will still take some months to be completed, and once that is done, I will be happy to announce a release date for a free Demo that will be available to all of you on this Steam Page.

Good News coming soon, I wish to all of you Callers a great day

🐸🚂 Frogtrain
